Context: TEP4175 wind turbine blade design (NTNU). Z = 2 blades, V1 = 12 m/s, R = 0.45 m, N = 15 elements, hub radius 30 mm. Structural requirements along the whole blade: chord 40 to about 100 mm, max thickness at least 5 mm (so t/c at least 12.5% at a 40 mm tip). Chord from optimum BEM (with wake rotation) scales as 1/(Cl·λ²), so the 40 mm tip chord sets a maximum design Cl for each design tip speed ratio λ.
